title: On linear $k$-graphs with codegree Turán density arbitrarily close to zero
summary: Let $F$ be a $k$-uniform hypergraph, abbreviated as $k$-graph. The codegree Turán density $π_{\mathrm{co}}(F)$ is the supremum over all $γ\in [0,1)$ such that, for arbitrarily large $n$, there exists an $n$-vertex $F$-free $k$-graph $H$ whose every $(k-1)$-subset of vertices lies in at least $γn$ edges. In this paper, we prove that there is a linear $k$-graph $F$ with $0 0$. The special case $k=3$ solve a question proposed by Ding, Lamaison, Liu, Wang and Yang (JLMS, 2025).
